stage1.impression: A warm, dark slatted-oak room with two red acrylic speakers on terrazzo blocks and a multicoloured neon-ringed sphere between them. It reads as a competent CG mockup rather than a photograph: the floor and rug are flat, untextured planes, the speakers' inner panels glow a blown candy pink that looks like signage, the sphere's rings are saturated tube colours that compete with the speakers, and the room is empty, with a hard white disc on the floor. As it stands it is a well-lit generic render of a listening room, not a specific place a design magazine would run: the slat walls and plinths are handsome, but nothing at 1:1 says real oak, real terrazzo or real end grain, and there is no sign of life.

blocking_9: The speakers read at a glance as tinted cast acrylic: the inner faces not clipped (clip_pct < 0.5 in each speaker box) and each cabinet's median luminance at 45 or more
Mother EARF's coloured shadow reads on the floor as a soft coloured pool, not a hard white disc with a cut edge
The floor and the rug show real material at 1:1 (end-grain oak blocks, rug pile) rather than smooth flat planes
Signs of life: a few motion-blurred listeners, a glass, a record out of its sleeve
The right plinth and the floor in front of it hold detail (crush_pct < 10)
The wordless reading 'generic bar' goes away: the lantern's identity (end-grain floor, slotted baffle, amber band) shows in the frame

defects.what: Right Tropos: inner panels blown flat pink (clip 2.65 %), red body otherwise dark (median 19.7); reads as lit signage, not cast acrylic
Left Tropos: same blown pink inner faces (clip 4.0 %), median 32.8, below 45
Right horn: wobbly, zebra-like slat reflections in the acrylic read as distorted plastic
Mother EARF's spot lands as a hard-edged near-white elliptical disc (p95 161) instead of a coloured shadow; reads as a stage gobo
Floor/rug is a single smooth flat plane (lum_range 47, no texture): no end grain, no pile, reads CG
Right plinth and its base nearly crushed (median 8.6, crush 18.6 %)
Foreground chair back a dark, featureless slab (median 8.3) blocking the lower centre
Bare point hotspot on the ceiling, a visible CG lamp
No people, glasses or records: an empty showroom, not a room in use
Black slab at left edge (record shelf/console) reads as an untextured box

changes.problem: The speakers' inner faces are blown to flat pink while the bodies sit too dark, so the Tropos read as glowing signage instead of thick tinted acrylic.

evidence.measured: median 19.7, p95 176.8, clip 2.65 %; left speaker [330,350,445,525] median 32.8, clip 4.0 %; RGB median (71,4,1)

change.setting: inside the lantern: the pair 2 x spot (W, deg)
change.to: 32 W, 40 deg, aimed 0.3 m higher so the beam fills the cabinet and catches the horn and front edges rather than burning into the inner panels

changes.expected: Cabinets read as evenly lit red acrylic with glowing polished edges; inner faces hold tone; speakers become the brightest coloured thing in the frame without clipping.

changes.problem: Speaker bodies are below the legibility floor once the hotspots are tamed; the cabinet's median must rise.

change.setting: inside the lantern: the trap 1 x area (W/m2) plus a soft back-graze on the wall behind each speaker
change.to: 0.45 W/m2, so light comes through the acrylic from behind and the tint glows

changes.expected: The red reads through the body, not only on the front faces; speaker median rises to about 50.

changes.problem: Mother EARF's spot makes a hard white gobo disc on the floor instead of her coloured shadow, which is a CG/stage tell.

evidence.measured: p95 161.3, near-neutral RGB median (73,45,30), sharp elliptical edge

change.setting: inside the lantern: Mother EARF 1 x spot
change.to: 45 W, 30 deg, 2700 K, with a 0.15 m soft radius, aimed so the beam passes through the discs before reaching the floor

changes.expected: A soft-edged multi-tinted shadow pool on the floor, peak below ~110, no visible ellipse edge.

changes.problem: The floor and rug are smooth, untextured planes, the clearest sign of CG and the reason the room reads generic.

evidence.measured: lum_range 47.6, p5 4.7 to p95 52.3, no visible grain or pile at 3x crop

change.setting: end-grain oak floor and rug finish
change.to: end-grain oak blocks (60-90 mm, each with growth rings, slight tone variation, 1 mm joints, oiled low sheen) and a wool rug with pile bump and fibre variation

changes.expected: At 1:1 the floor reads as real end-grain blocks; the rug as wool; local contrast rises.

changes.problem: The room is empty, a showroom, with no sign of life.

evidence.measured: card: people 0 figures; no glasses or records visible

change.to: 2 seated figures in the lounge chairs (left chairs and right edge), motion-blurred, faces away; a tumbler on a side surface; one record out of its sleeve on the left console

changes.expected: The frame reads as a room in use, as the card intends.

changes.problem: The right plinth and the floor beside it are crushed, so the terrazzo, a fixed lasting material, disappears.

change.setting: inside the lantern: fill 1 x area

changes.expected: Terrazzo chips legible on both plinths; shadows deep but not empty.

changes.problem: A foreground chair back is a dark, featureless slab across the lower centre, and the frame doesn't show the lantern's identity (slotted baffle, amber band).

evidence.measured: lum_median 8.3, crush 6.2; chair occupies about 12 % of the frame

change.to: move 0.4 m to the right of the chair and 0.1 m lower (seated eye level about 1.05 m), 32 mm, so the chair arm frames the lower-left corner and the centre floor and the shadow pool run clear

changes.expected: No dead slab in the lower centre; the pair, Mother and her shadow read as one composition.

changes.problem: A bare point hotspot on the ceiling and a hard light pattern at the top centre read as a visible CG lamp.

evidence.measured: small near-white blob at the top edge; top band [360,0,1200,230] crush 13 %

change.from: point-like source visible at the lid
change.to: hide the source behind the lid slats or swap it for the band's soft emission at 0.2, so the lid gets an even amber wash

changes.expected: No visible lamp point; the ceiling gets a soft warm gradient.

out_of_scope.request: Calm Mother EARF's saturated blue, green, yellow and pink rims so the Tropos are the only saturated colour
out_of_scope.why: Mother EARF and her tinted discs are a fixed EARF product as placed; only her spot can change, and that alone cannot remove the rims' colour. The 'one colour' criterion conflicts with the card here.

out_of_scope.request: Reduce the distorted, zebra-like reflections in the Tropos horn
out_of_scope.why: The horn's shape and surface are part of the speaker, which may not be changed; only the lighting and wall reflections around it can be adjusted.

out_of_scope.request: Thicker, more visibly cast acrylic edges on the speaker cabinets
